headlines.summary: '리더스포럼' 정책토론회…"제조 AI 도입한 기업, 0.1%에 불과" 전국 중소기업인 400명 참석해 23일까지 중소기업 성장 해법 논의 2026 중소기업 리더스포럼 21일 롯데호텔 제주에서 열린 '2026 중소기업 리더스포럼' 참석자들이 기념 촬영을 하고 있다. [중소기업중앙회 제공.

headlines.title: 정부 , 내년 가상자산 과세 앞두고 의견수렴
headlines.summary: 내년 1월 가상자산 과세 시행을 앞두고 유예 요구 목소리가 나오는 가운데 정부가 의견 수렴에 나섰습니다. 재정경제부는 어제(20일) 서울지방조달청에서 금융위원회와 전문가, 업계 관계자 등이 참석한 가운데 가상자산 과세 관련 현장 간담회를 개최했습니다.

headlines.title: “ 과세 유예만으 로는 가상자산 못살려 … 관련법 통과가 먼저”
headlines.summary: 업계, 당국 과세 신중론에 반색 디지털자산기본법 여전히 계류 그사이 자산 63조원 해외 유출 “연내 처리돼야 한 단계 도약” 내년 1월 시행을 앞둔 가상자산 소득 과세를 두고 정부 내부에서도 신중론이 확산하고 있다. 가상자산 투자에 관심이 높은 청년층 지지율 하락으로 정치적 부담이 커지면서다.

headlines.title: 국회, ‘ 가상자산 과세 폐지 ’ 반대했지만 … [이슈&뷰]
headlines.summary: 재경위 “번복땐 신뢰훼손” 검토보고서 정부도 ‘과세에 문제없다’ 입장 제출 시기는 열어놔, 과세 유예 가능성도 내년 1월 시행을 앞둔 가상자산 과세를 두고 형평성과 제도 미비를 이유로 폐지·유예 요구가 이어지는 가운데, 이미 세 차례 미룬 과세 방침까지 뒤집으면 조세정책의 신뢰도가 흔들릴 수 있다는 국회 보고서가 나왔다.

headlines.title: 정부는 집값 안정된다는데 … 경기 상승률, 서울 앞질렀다
headlines.summary: ■ 주택 공급부족 후폭풍 9월 경기 0.82% - 서울 0.74%↑ 영통 등 규제지역은 1%대 상승 서울, 강남·서초 빼고 모두 올라 3기 신도시 착공률도 14% 그쳐 정부는 연일 ‘시장 안정 흐름’이란 메시지를 내고 있지만 지난달 서울 25개 자치구 중 강남·서초구를 제외한 23개구 집값이 모두 올라 정부 인식과 거리가 멀어지는 양상이 나타나고 있다.

headlines.title: 생산자 물가는 0.2%↑ … 농산물·석유 중심 두달째 상승
headlines.summary: 배추 42%·쇠고기 10% 급등 컴퓨터·전자기기는 1.7%↓ 추석 명절 수요와 여름철 전기요금 감면 종료가 겹치면서 9월 생산자물가가 두 달 연속 올랐다. 원화 강세로 달러 기준으로 거래되는 전자부품과 중간재·최종재 수입품 가격은 내렸다.

headlines.title: 10월 수출 616억 弗… 연간 1조 弗 가시권
headlines.summary: 지난해 같은 기간보다 105% 급증 반도체 275억달러, 전체의 44.7% 내달 사상 첫 연 1조弗 돌파 기대 대미흑자 최대 전망, 통상압박 변수 수출 컨테이너가 산적한 인천 신항 전경.  [IPA 제공] 이달 1~20일 수출액이 반도체 호황에 힘입어 600억달러를 넘어섰다. 지난해 같은 기간보다 2배 이상 늘어난 규모다.

headlines.title: 피크아웃 우려에도 … 반도체 업은 수출, 또 역대최대
headlines.summary: 이달 1~20일 기준 616억 달러 인공지능(AI) 반도체의 ‘피크아웃(고점 통과)’ 우려가 커지고 있지만, 반도체 수출 호조에 힘입어 한국의 일평균 수출액이 역대 최대를 기록했다. 현재 수출 추세가 이어질 경우 사상 처음으로 두 달 연속 월간 수출액이 1000억 달러를 돌파할 것으로 예상된다.

headlines.title: 10월 중순 수출 616억달러, 작년의 2배 … 일평균 또 역대 최대(종합)
headlines.summary: 반도체 223% 급증…내달 수출 1조달러 돌파 관측 분주한 평택항 (평택=연합뉴스) 홍기원 기자 = 경기도 평택항에 컨테이너가 쌓여있는 모습. 2026.7.24 xanadu@yna.co.kr (세종=연합뉴스) 안채원 기자 = 이달 중순 수출액이 작년의 두 배로 뛰면서 고공행진을 이어가고 있다.

headlines.title: 10월 1~20일 수출 616억달러, 105.4% 증가 … 동기간 역대 최대
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 관세청, 2026년 10월 1~20일 수출입 현황(잠정치) 발표 연합뉴스 10월 1~20일 한국 수출이 616억달러를 기록하며 10월 같은 기간 기준으로 역대 최대 실적을 기록했다. 일평균 수출액은 사상 최대치로 집계됐다. 관세청은 이달 1~20일 수출입 현황 잠정치를 집계한 결과 수출액이 616억 1200달러로 전년 동기 대비 105.

headlines.title: 알래스카 LNG 사업비 440억 →880억달러까지…韓투자 '비용 리스크'
headlines.summary: 美의회 의뢰 보고서 "비용 상승이 최대 난관" 사업비 추정 오차범위 -50~+100%…FEED도 아직 정부 "투자 여부·규모 미정…상업성·투자조건 협의 중" 한국 정부가 미국 전략투자 후보로 검토 중인 알래스카 액화천연가스(LNG) 개발사업을 두고 사업비와 세금, 금융조달 조건 등이 주요 변수로 떠올랐다.

headlines.title: 관세청, 내달 글로벌 무역장벽 논의 ‘ KCW 2026 ’
headlines.summary: 미국의 관세정책 변화와 유럽연합(EU)의 환경규제 강화에 대응해 관세청이 주요국과 관세협력 강화에 나선다. 8개국 관세당국 고위급과 우리 수출기업의 통관 애로 해소 방안을 논의하고, 미국·EU의 정책 담당자를 초청해 기업 대응을 지원한다.

headlines.title: 취업문 좁아지고 일해도 짧게 … 청년 고용 ‘ 이중절벽 ’
headlines.summary: 올 취업자수 증가폭, 코로나 후 최저 반도체 초호황에도 ‘신규고용’은 위축 9월 청년 취업자 47개월째↓ ‘한파’ 6명 중 1명 ‘초단기’ 일자리 질 악화 정부, 청년고용예산 5.1조·41% 증액 수출을 비롯한 거시경제 지표가 호조를 보고 있지만, 취업 기회 감소와 일자리 질 악화의 이중고 속에 청년 고용시장은 여전히 냉랭하다.

top5_headlines.summary: 지난해 같은 기간보다 105% 급증 반도체 275억달러, 전체의 44.7% 내달 사상 첫 연 1조弗 돌파 기대 대미흑자 최대 전망, 통상압박 변수 수출 컨테이너가 산적한 인천 신항 전경.  [IPA 제공] 이달 1~20일 수출액이 반도체 호황에 힘입어 600억달러를 넘어섰다. 지난해 같은 기간보다 2배 이상 늘어난 규모다.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Housing Prices Rise Broadly Despite Government Stabilization Claims
key_headlines.summary: September housing prices in Seoul rose 0.82% compared to 0.74% nationally, with 23 of 25 districts excluding Gangnam and Seocho seeing increases. Third new city construction starts remain at only 14% of target, contradicting government stability messaging.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Exports Hit Record High Despite AI Peak Concerns
key_headlines.summary: October daily average exports reached a historic 61.6 billion dollars in first 20 days, with semiconductors accounting for 44.7% of total. South Korea is expected to surpass 100 billion dollars in monthly exports for the first time.

key_headlines.title: Producer Price Index Rises for Second Consecutive Month
key_headlines.summary: September producer prices increased 0.2% from previous month and 7.7% year-over-year, driven by agricultural products up 2.6% and electricity costs rising 13.4%. Cabbage prices surged 42% and beef 10% due to Chuseok demand.

key_headlines.title: Monthly Jeonse Rentals Exceed 50% in Seoul for First Time
key_headlines.summary: Jeonse (long-term lease) transactions dropped 27% through September, with monthly rentals surpassing 50% of apartment leases in Seoul. Jongno-gu recorded the highest monthly ratio at 65.6% due to lending regulations and land zoning effects.

key_headlines.title: France Government Bond Yield Approaches 5%, Nearing Greek Crisis Levels
key_headlines.summary: French 10-year bond yields have climbed near 5% annually amid fiscal concerns and civil unrest. France's fiscal deficit outlook revised from 6% to 12% of GDP, approaching the severity of Greece's 2009 crisis.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's export sector is booming despite concerns about AI semiconductor market saturation, with October daily average exports setting a historic record of 61.6 billion dollars. Housing markets show persistent upward pressure in Seoul, contradicting government stabilization efforts, as 23 out of 25 districts recorded price increases excluding Gangnam and Seocho. The government is intensifying efforts to strengthen tariff cooperation with eight major countries to address global trade barriers stemming from U.S. tariff policy changes and EU environmental regulations. Producer prices continue rising for the second consecutive month, driven by agricultural product inflation and energy costs, which may pressure consumer prices ahead.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's economic growth remains robust at 3.8% in Q1 and 3.7% in Q2 this year, a dramatic improvement from near-zero growth in the same period last year, primarily driven by exports and manufacturing sector recovery. September producer prices increased 0.2% month-over-month and 7.7% year-over-year, with agricultural products and energy costs being main drivers despite electronics price declines from strong won. Youth employment remains sluggish despite overall economic improvement, with labor market indicators showing weak hiring despite GDP growth and export expansion. Long-term interest rates are expected to peak between Q4 2026 and Q1 2027, reflecting growth expectations and inflation concerns rather than recession signals. Accumulated energy cost burdens are projected to push consumer price inflation higher in coming months despite recent producer price gains being limited by currency strength.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korea's stock market continues to decline sharply, with KOSPI falling 3.73% to 5,552.74 and KOSDAQ dropping 3.33% to 781.97 as foreign and institutional investors sell simultaneously. U.S. Treasury bond yields remain elevated amid inflation concerns and AI investment-driven monetary dynamics, creating headwinds for equity markets globally. France's government bond crisis is intensifying with yields approaching 5%, triggering broader European financial market volatility and potentially impacting Korean stock markets through foreign investor repositioning. Market consensus suggests U.S. Federal Reserve rates may peak in Q4 2026 to Q1 2027, with further uncertainty around December FOMC decisions and potential additional hikes through March 2027. Experts debate Korean stock market recovery conditions as investor anxiety rises, with disagreements on timing of rebound and recovery speed given external macroeconomic pressures.
sections.Industry & Technology: Chinese battery giant CATL's third-quarter earnings disappointed markets, causing its stock to plummet 11% as profit growth decelerated to 14.5%, the lowest level in two years despite revenue surging 58.6% year-over-year. CATL and Huawei are collaborating to advance electric vehicle battery swap technology, developing systems where vehicles autonomously enter exchange stations for automatic battery replacement integrated with autonomous driving capabilities. Samsung Asset Management's solid-state battery and energy storage ETF surged to 200 billion won in net assets as these technologies expand beyond electric vehicles into humanoid robots, urban air mobility, and aerospace applications. The World Bank president indicated active discussions with Korean companies on electric vehicle and battery sector investments in developing nations, highlighting opportunities across manufacturing, logistics, and technology transfer. International battery and EV charging infrastructure markets are evolving rapidly with Korean and Chinese companies competing for technological leadership in autonomous charging systems.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment monthly rental proportions exceeded 50% for the first time in September, with jeonse leases declining 27% as rental supply constraints drive prices higher in the competitive market. Apartment prices in Daechi-dong, Seoul's premier private academy district, command a premium of 68 million won above Gangnam district average, demonstrating how educational infrastructure concentration creates significant price differentials. The government continues implementing mortgage lending restrictions with speculation about limiting loans to 6 billion won for properties under 1.5 billion won and reducing stress test rate floors, potentially further constraining housing supply. Third new city development progress remains sluggish at only 14% of annual construction targets despite government acceleration directives, maintaining pressure on housing prices as supply lags demand. Rumors of stricter mortgage lending policies, if implemented, could further restrict housing market liquidity and accelerate monthly rental price inflation in major metropolitan areas.
sections.International Economy: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Besent indicated the Trump administration will maintain aggressive tariff policies regardless of midterm election outcomes, signaling tariffs will persist beyond the current administration period. The U.S. Federal Reserve faces a policy dilemma with housing market weakness contrasting inflation pressures, creating uncertainty around interest rate decisions in late October and December with potential March 2027 increases. U.S. consumer consumption weakened with continued inflation pressures, forcing the Fed to balance housing market support against persistent price growth concerns. Korean consumer goods export markets shifted significantly with Europe surpassing China and North America as the top destination since February 2026, growing at 16% annually and reaching 8.4 billion dollars annually. Global investment community debates whether the U.S. housing market crisis and inflation persistence warrant additional Federal Reserve rate increases despite traditional recession indicators.
sections.AI & Economy: Goldman Sachs warned that U.S. AI growth could be constrained by power supply limitations, with global data center electricity demand projected to increase 170% between 2025 and 2030, and major tech companies like Amazon unable to operate all procured AI equipment due to power shortages. South Korea's power equipment industry sees market expansion opportunities as Nvidia adopts 800-volt direct current systems for AI data centers, reducing transmission losses and creating demand for domestic power conversion technology and systems. Data center cooling markets are projected to expand beyond 17.2 billion dollars by 2030 with annual liquid cooling growth of 15%, representing significant import replacement opportunities for Korean equipment manufacturers currently importing 100% of cooling equipment. South Korea's 22.3 billion dollar Texas power plant investment faces scrutiny as market skepticism grows regarding AI infrastructure investment profitability and returns. Korean defense contractors HD Hyundai and Hanwha are developing AI-integrated autonomous naval vessels with global technology partners, positioning South Korea to capture emerging unmanned military ship markets as the U.S. Navy accelerates unmanned fleet integration.
sections.Others: The government launched the 2026 Export Boom-up Korea event with major global companies including Lonza, JD.com, and Mitsubishi Electric participating to expand Korean SME export opportunities. South Korea's disaster recovery systems for critical building permit infrastructure remain inadequate, with only 3 out of 142 systems maintaining full backup while priority-level systems lack recovery capacity, creating vulnerabilities during emergencies. The Small and Medium Business Administration held meetings with SME and startup leaders to expand participation in three mega projects worth 1.5 trillion won-plus in semiconductors, AI data centers, and physical AI sectors. BioGen announced continued participation in BIX 2026 biotech conference maintaining four-year participation streak with focus on contract manufacturing organization competitiveness and production facility expansion. Government and private sector initiatives increasingly focus on SME participation in mega-infrastructure projects and export market diversification to sustain economic growth momentum.
